# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and perf hardening**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and a Vulkan-via-Silk.NET package, plus several native leak fixes. Alongside the new GPU surface, this release fixes several native use-after-free and memory leaks, adds containerized Linux/Alpine/Nano Server test legs, and converts all solutions to the new .slnx format.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to Chrome milestone m152** — Updates the bundled Skia engine to m152, folding in upstream stability fixes merged during the preview cycle. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous, backend-neutral pixel reads. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free and leak fixes** — Fixes a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create's raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Performance improvements across the hot path** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and cuts a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Platform

- **Broader test and Windows build coverage** — Adds containerized Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test legs, initializes the MSVC environment once per native build, stops pinning a default Windows SDK version, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font support. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche), [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No HarfBuzz API changes; the binding picks up the .slnx solution-format conversion and the new containerized test legs alongside the rest of the repo.
